description: The bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment” illustrates the runtime (in seconds) for a set of models, contrasting “Our Joint Framework” with several “LLM Models.” The horizontal axis contains the model categories in left-to-right order: Our Joint Framework, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude, with labels angled; no explicit x-axis label is shown. The vertical axis is labeled “Runtime (seconds)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 up to a little over 400, with evenly spaced tick marks at 50-second intervals. There are five single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars: “Our Joint Framework” is shown in dark green at approximately 77 seconds (value label “77” above the bar), while the LLM model bars are shown in a muted blue-gray: ChatGPT at about 190 seconds (“190”), DeepSeek at about 365 seconds (“365”), LLaMA at about 172 seconds (“172”), and Claude at about 243 seconds (“243”). A legend in the upper-left distinguishes the dark green bar as “Our Joint Framework” and the blue-gray bars as “LLM Models,” and the bars appear in the fixed category order rather than being sorted by height, with numeric annotations above each bar and no additional visual emphasis such as outlines or callouts beyond the value labels.
